featureCard.beforeCustomCode: Custom CSS and JS for the old sidebar doesn't run on New Design Experience. You can switch it back on to compare.
featureCard.beforePlan: How much you can customize depends on your plan.
featureCard.beforeTurnOff: Turning New Design Experience off brings back the old navigation but doesn't keep your layout.
featureCard.previewNote: Opens in a new tab, only for you. Nothing to undo.
featureCard.spotlightFindBody: Pin the pages you live in, jump back to recent ones, and search any page, setting or record.
featureCard.spotlightSameBody: Every feature works as it does today. New Design Experience changes how you move, not what you can do.
featureCard.spotlightTemplateBody: Save a layout as a template and push it to every sub-account. One push updates them all.
featureCard.spotlightYoursBody: Rename, reorder and hide groups so each sub-account looks built for its business.
